notes.title: 📢Announcement: A major patch has just been released!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We are excited to announce 📢 that a major patch has just been released! We've worked hard to include as many of your requests as possible. Enjoy the new updates🎈

✔️ New: Rapid Company Mode – A setting that makes company sales much easier, ideal for faster business progress.
✔️ New: Easy Flirt Mode – Enables automatic success in flirting tasks, perfect for unlocking remaining adult scenes.
✔️ Normal Company Mode Fine-Tune – Slightly improved progression balance in normal difficulty.
✔️ Compact Passes – Shortened passes for quicker progression and faster access to special rewards.
✔️ Faster Attribute Upgrades – Character attributes are now much cheaper to upgrade, speeding up cafe business gameplay.
✔️ Easier Cloth Activation – All outfits now cost just 1 Cloth Token, regardless of rarity.
✔️ Task Polish – Brand upgrades are no longer required for tasks, so no need to save up for them.
✔️ Glow Adjustment Fix – Corrected glow effects that didn’t work on some screens or devices.
✔️ Reward Boosts – Increased the amount of rewards both for level-ups and passes.

Thanks for your feedback! 🙏🏽

More updates coming soon—stay tuned! 🚀
